title: HOLON result record v2 (additive to the frozen schemas/result_record.schema.json)
description: One field per whitepaper §8.6 item: status, statement_hash (law hash), model_sha256 (model hash), premises, scope_v2, kernels, independence_class, refinement_refs, replay (witness replay status), coverage. A field a later iteration fills holds the constant 'pending:I<n>'; that iteration replaces the constant here and asserts the removal in its own test (non_vacuity: filled by I3; refinement_refs: filled by I16; coverage: filled by I19, so no field is pending).

prover.description: I41 (whitepaper 9.1, 10.4): who proved what. generator for every record the pipelines decide (a proof generator, a counter-law, or UNKNOWN); agent:<session> only on a PROVED record whose proof is the agent's inbox submission the prover intake accepted (holon.intake). No pending value.

compiled_sha256.description: sha256 of the compiled model (.mjs) the refuter executed

generator_sha256.description: sha256 over the generator entry modules and every holon module they import

ledger_match.description: committed records match their ledger bundle by facts sha256; 'derived' (a run over facts derived from a registered file, e.g. planted mutations) never validates

ledger_assumptions.description: M2+ records only (audit M2/1 F-M2-12): the ledger entries meeting the cone that the model does not replace by an oracle parameter (abstractions, stand-ins still inside the model); model_assumptions holds the hypothesis premises (§8.5)

statement_scope.description: holon-ir/0.3 records (audit F-M2-01): the statement's IR scope, verbatim; scope and scope_v2 follow it, never the status

source.description: lean4 (I9): the Lean file that carries the verdict, repo-relative

source_sha256.description: lean4 (I9): sha256 of the Lean text emitted for this law, facts, status and witness; checked only if gen/<m>/lean/report.json checked exactly this text

theorem.description: lean4 (I9): the theorem carrying the verdict (the law, or its counter-law)

axioms.description: lean4 (I9): `#print axioms` of the checked theorems; only propext and Quot.sound are allowed

disch.description: I31 (additive): a DISCH law's DERIVATION.json entry without statement_hash (holon.disch.run)

refinement_refs.description: I16: the refinement records of the edges the cone uses (holon.records.refinement_refs): per-edge records under results/M2/refinement/ and trace-corpus per_action entries of replay/<m>/report.json. 'pending:I16' is no longer accepted.

coverage.description: I19 (holon.records.coverage_field): for an M2+ law whose facts document is an extracted document, its numbers of debt entries and unaccounted statements in gen/<milestone>/coverage.json; null otherwise. 'pending:I19' is no longer accepted.

evidence_levels.description: I14: holon.diagram.evidence.law_evidence(law, gen/M2/evidence.json)['levels'] (sorted, distinct) when the evidence set covers the law's facts; null otherwise

evidence_triage.description: I14: evidence_triage(status, max level): none unless REFUTED, then intent_question iff the strongest level is E6, else finding. The frozen v1 triage is unchanged

site.description: I15: a SORT-site law's I13 site id (DERIVATION.json basis.site_id)

width_site.description: I20: a SORT-width law's store (holon.sorts.width): its span, the field it narrows into and the field's width in bits

witnesses.description: I15: a SORT-site law's refutation per entry point: {} when PROVED, else one entry per entry point (DERIVATION.json entry_points)

evidence_override.description: I14: null, or exactly config/evidence_overrides.json[<M>][<law_id>] (a human's recorded judgment)

allOf.$comment: I41: an agent prover only on a PROVED record (an agent's refused submission leaves the record its generators wrote)
0.1/0.2 records (no statement_scope): scope_v2 is the search's, bounded exactly when UNKNOWN (M0/M1, pinned)
0.3 records: scope comes from statement.scope, never from the status (whitepaper 8.6; audit F-M2-01)
